faqs.q: What are the main benefits of the SBI Tata Card?
faqs.a: SBI Tata Card offers reward benefits on Tata outlets, Croma purchases, departmental stores, and grocery spends. Cardholders can earn Empower Points on eligible transactions.

faqs.q: What is the annual fee of the SBI Tata Card?
faqs.a: SBI Tata Card has an annual fee of Rs. 499 plus applicable taxes. The fee can be waived if the cardholder spends Rs. 1,00,000 in a year.

faqs.q: How can consumers earn welcome benefits on the SBI Tata Card?
faqs.a: Cardholders can earn 500 Empower Points by spending Rs. 2,000 within 60 days of card activation. Additional gift vouchers may also be provided.

faqs.q: What is the reward redemption value for SBI Tata Card points?
faqs.a: The accumulated reward points earned through the SBI Tata Card can be redeemed at a value of 1 Empower Point equal to Rs. 1.

faqs.q: Does the SBI Tata Card provide fuel surcharge waiver benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, the card provides a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on eligible transactions between Rs. 500 and Rs. 3,000, capped at Rs. 100 per month.

faqs.q: Does the SBI Tata Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.a: No, the SBI Tata Card does not provide airport lounge access benefits. Consumers looking for travel-related features may need to consider other credit card options.
